note: Cherokee County AL says it has no zoning regulations outside incorporated areas. The cities (Centre, Cedar Bluff, Leesburg, Gaylesville, Sand Rock) zone their own land, but the only zoning found is PDF: Centre's 2013 zoning ordinance with its Official Zoning Map, and the Cedar Bluff and Centre comprehensive plans. No ArcGIS REST or other queryable zoning districts service was found for the county or its cities. The county GIS viewer (isv.kcsgis.com) has city limits and parcels but no zoning layer, and it was unreachable from here. gis.cherokeega.com is Cherokee County, Georgia, so it does not apply.
